import_provenance.original_title: Isomorphism of tree-automatic ordinals without addition
import_provenance.original_statement: Is there an algorithm deciding whether two promised well-orders presented by finite-tree automata are isomorphic, when only their domains and order relations are supplied? Jain and coauthors solve the version with an automatic ordinal-addition operation, leaving this weaker presentation open.
